needed.evidence: No footway is present on the left side of the road, forcing pedestrians into the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous and usable sidewalk along the left side of the street.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk on the right is partially obstructed by snow and debris, reducing its usability
needed.suggestion: Clear and maintain the right-hand sidewalk to ensure its continuous and usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and potentially hazardous sections on the sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and maintain the sidewalk to eliminate any trip hazards and make it safe for pedestrian use.

needed.evidence: People crossing the carriageway without a dedicated crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing or pedestrian refuge at this location to provide a safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting, particularly visible at night and in dim conditions
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure adequate illumination along the entire road segment.
